description: Generate a robots.txt file from one or more User-agent groups (each with Allow/Disallow rules and an optional Crawl-delay) plus a list of Sitemap URLs. The inverse of validate_robots_txt: a group with no Allow or Disallow rules gets an explicit empty Disallow line, the standard way to allow crawling everything.

groups.description: User-agent groups to emit, in order

crawlDelay.description: Crawl-delay in seconds for this group

userAgents.description: User-agent tokens for this group, e.g. ["*"] or ["Googlebot"]

sitemaps.description: Absolute sitemap URLs to append as Sitemap directives

name: generate_robots_txt
